component.name: Fedora Glass
component.summary: A glass look for GNOME and your apps, from clear to frosted
component.project_license: MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND GPL-3.0-only AND GPL-2.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0

description.p: Fedora Glass gives GNOME Shell, GTK and Qt apps a glass look, drawn by its own GNOME Shell extension: the top bar, menus, the overview, the lock screen and the windows. A customizer app tunes it from clear liquid glass to calm frost.
It changes only your own user settings, can put your original look back at any time, and works with Dash to Panel, Dash to Dock, ArcMenu and Spawn, or on stock GNOME with none of them.

ul.li: Looks, colours, accent and dark or light, with a live preview
Motion styles for opening, closing and minimizing windows
Mouse pointer styles, including glass ones
Optional glass on the login screen
Restore original and Remove in one click

screenshot.caption: The customizer, with a live preview of the glass
Glass on the top bar, menus and windows

description.p: Sturdier: a failed Apply or a damaged settings file never changes your look, a lighter background helper, faster window drags, and many app fixes.
A preview big enough to judge the glass, close up by default, and a little less memory.
A simpler app: a sidebar of pages, search for settings, and a faster start.
Mouse pointer styles, clearer app, safer backups, and signing that checks where a release was built.
Less memory, cheaper glass, lighter window drags and less idle CPU.
Full-screen games get direct display again, and hidden window glass frees its memory.
